plugin.name: directional-focus
plugin._long: Move keyboard focus to the nearest window in a direction, treating all outputs as one logical desktop. Only windows on the current workspace are considered; focus never wraps and never changes workspace, but it will cross a monitor boundary when the nearest window in that direction is on another output.

option.name: focus_left
option._long: Move keyboard focus to the nearest window left of the focused one.

option.name: focus_right
option._long: Move keyboard focus to the nearest window right of the focused one.

option.name: focus_up
option._long: Move keyboard focus to the nearest window above the focused one.

option.name: focus_down
option._long: Move keyboard focus to the nearest window below the focused one.

option.name: perp_weight
option._long: How strongly to prefer a window level with the travel direction over one nearer but offset sideways. 1.0 treats both axes equally; higher values keep focus travelling straighter. Never selects a window behind the source.

option.name: debug_log
option._long: Log each focus move to the journal.
